name: Turks and Caicos Islands

flag.description: A Blue Ensign with a yellow shield in the fly bearing a queen conch shell, a spiny lobster and a Turk's cap cactus.
flag.symbolism: The conch and lobster represent the islands' marine life and fishing, and the Turk's cap cactus, whose red top looks like a fez, gave the Turks Islands their name.

hook: Turks and Caicos puts a seafood-and-cactus trio on a plain yellow shield: a conch, a lobster and the fez-topped cactus that named the Turks Islands.
trivia: Whether the lobster on the badge should have eight or ten legs has long been disputed; the real Caribbean spiny lobster has ten.
The capital, Cockburn Town, is on Grand Turk, but most of the population lives on Providenciales.
